topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Well, now, I never thought I’d hear such tales from old Bill. He’s always been one to tell a story or two, but this beats the reaping. Says his friend Tom, who we all thought was mending roofs up the valley, has been spending his days in the bishop’s library, or so he says now. Can you imagine? Tom, the one who barely knows a scythe from a hoe, reading all day? I reckon the ale must’ve got the better of him at the tavern, or maybe the devil himself whispered in his ear to spin such a yarn. I’m off to pay Tom a visit. Maybe a bit of honest work in the fields might set him straight.
